results.title: Broken Ceramic: Repurposed Garden Hacks That Saved Sheds
results.description: Broken ceramic planters often end up in landfills, but their fragments can be repurposed into wall-mounted storage systems for garden workshops or sheds. Instead of attempting to glue shattered vessels, gardeners can use surviving sections as open-face bins. This approach eliminates the need for plastic containers while maintaining a natural material aesthetic in utility buildings. Material selection and safety preparation To create a functional wall pocket, only fragments that retain their bottom and intact side walls are suitable; ideally, the pot should have split vertically into nearly equal halves. Small shards or flat pieces lack the volume required for storage and should be discarded. It is critical to inspect the piece for "spider-web" internal cracks, which can cause the structure to fail under the weight of tools. Because ceramic fractures create sharp edges capable of causing deep cuts, all edges must be smoothed using a coarse abrasive block or sandpaper. This process requires eye and hand protection due to the aggressive nature of ceramic dust. Engineer Aleksey Tikhonov notes that ceramics are fragile under point pressure; because frost-induced micro-cracks may be invisible, sanding should be done without excessive force to avoid completely shattering the workpiece.

results.title: Jr NTR shares health update after shoulder surgery: “The surgery was successful, I’m doing well”
results.description: Jr NTR has shared an update on his health after undergoing shoulder surgery at KIMS Hospitals in Secunderabad. The actor took to social media to thank his fans, friends and family for their prayers and support following the procedure. Jr NTR underwent an arthroscopic shoulder surgery on August 12 after sustaining an injury on July 27, 2026. Following the injury, doctors had advised him to take complete rest for six to eight weeks. While some reports claimed that the injury may have occurred during an activity, others linked it to the shoot of his upcoming film Dragon. However, his team has not officially confirmed the circumstances surrounding the injury. Sharing his health update on X, Jr NTR expressed gratitude for the support he received from fans. He wrote, "I am overwhelmed by the outpouring of love and prayers from all of you." The actor further assured everyone about his recovery, saying, "The surgery was successful and I’m doing well. My heartfelt gratitude to the amazing team of doctors at KIMS." NTR Health Bulletin released by KIMS hospital. ⁦@tarak9999⁩ pic.twitter.com/A1wgn2KFEv — .... (@ynakg2) August 12, 2026 He also thanked those closest to him and his followers for standing by him during the recovery period. "To my friends, family, and fans; your support gives me strength every single day. See you soon!" he wrote. According to a bulletin issued by KIMS Hospital, the procedure was successfully performed by a team of orthopaedic surgeons led by Dr RA Purnachandra Tejaswi, Dr Nithin Bejjanki, Dr Madhusudan Rao and Dr Srinivas Rao Surapaneni. Jr NTR is now expected to begin rehabilitation following the surgery. Reports suggest that while he has been advised to rest for six to eight weeks, it could take around two to three months for him to return to his normal activities. Soon after his post, fans flooded the comments with wishes for his speedy recovery. Messages including "Take Care Anna We Always With You. Jai NTR." and "Get well soon anna." reflected the support being extended to the actor as he recuperates.
